notes: Inbox: the dot beside an alert says whether you have read it (orange, or a ring once read) and taps to mark it read or unread. An alert you started a conversation from shows a speech bubble that opens that conversation, and its options offer Open the conversation before Start another. Suggested by Damon.
Projects in the sidebar switch is now a flag, a goal with a next step, so no two entries share a shape. Suggested by Damon.

The Vault, Files and Codex transcripts close four faults Casey found while re-checking 1.73.2: a public or share link no longer follows a symlink that replaced the stored file; a key rotation that stopped half-way is rolled back at start, so a passphrase set and later removed never moves the Vault to a key you were not shown; a Codex command keeps its exit code when a transcript page arrives late; and a Vault audit row that failed part-way no longer hides the next one.

The switch at the top of the sidebar names every entry under its icon (Chats, Projects, Files, Tasks, Vault, Inbox), with a distinct icon for each, when the sidebar is 300px or wider. Whatever the main area shows is underlined in orange, so Files opened in a tab is marked while the sidebar keeps listing your chats.

A message you type while Claude or Codex is waiting on a question no longer gets stuck behind it: the question is skipped and the agent reads your message in the same reply. The message box says so while a question waits; to answer instead, use the banner.

Inbox Watch reads your memory: before it decides on an email, and when it tidies your Inbox, it searches your past sessions and notes, so work you did outside email counts. A bug you already fixed in a session no longer comes in as a new alert, and an alert you settled in a session comes off your list with the session as the reason.
